name: Breyer Patch Farm
description: In Greeneville, TN, Breyer Patch Farm raises Blueberries, Blackberries, Flowers, and Honey on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
